title: Warm Spicy Moroccan Hazelnuts Sellou
description: A cozy Moroccan dish featuring hazelnuts, with a sour and cheese-pull texture, perfect for a cold evening. This high-protein-friendly sellou is made with a deglaze-fond for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped hazelnuts with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 10 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese until it is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the toasted hazelnuts to the skillet and stir until they are evenly coated with the cheese mixture.
